proves: The HIDC trailer is validated independently of the checksum. With bytes 42..45 zeroed and a checksum that is correct for that packet, the device replies with result 0x01 (not 0x02).

request.checksumAlgorithm: LE16 sum of bytes 0..45 inclusive (HIDC included)

notes: 0x01 and 0x02 are therefore distinct error classes: 0x02 = sum mismatch, 0x01 = trailer marker mismatch (or a superset error that marker failure hits).
Which check runs first when both are broken was NOT established; that experiment was voided when the device stopped answering (see findings).
